questions.collectsData: Does your business collect personal data (names, emails, phone numbers)?
questions.sensitiveData: Do you store health, biometric, or other sensitive personal data?

explanations.collectsData: The NDP Act applies to any processing of personal data of Nigerian citizens.
explanations.sensitiveData: Section 30 requires special protection for sensitive personal data including health and biometric information.
explanations.hasPrivacyPolicy: Section 27 requires a transparent and easily accessible privacy policy.
explanations.crossBorderTransfer: Sections 41-43 restrict data transfers to countries with adequate protection levels.
explanations.hasConsentMechanism: Section 26 requires specific, informed, and unambiguous consent.
explanations.targetsChildren: Section 31 requires age verification and parental consent for users under 18.
explanations.thirdPartySharing: Section 25 requires data processing agreements with third-party processors.
explanations.hasBreachProcess: Section 40 requires reporting data breaches within 72 hours to NDPC.
explanations.registeredWithNDPC: Section 44 requires registration as a data controller/processor of major importance.
explanations.usesAI: GAID 2025 Article 15 requires transparency for automated decision-making systems.

cbnQuestions.collectsData: Do you collect customer information for financial services?
cbnQuestions.kycVerification: Do you verify customer identity using BVN, NIN, or international passport?
cbnQuestions.pepScreening: Do you screen customers against Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) lists?
cbnQuestions.transactionMonitoring: Do you monitor transactions for suspicious activities in real-time?
cbnQuestions.strFiling: Do you report suspicious transactions to NFIU within 24 hours?
cbnQuestions.amlTraining: Do you provide annual AML/CFT training to all relevant employees?
cbnQuestions.recordKeeping: Do you retain transaction records for at least 5 years?
cbnQuestions.complianceOfficer: Have you designated an AML/CFT Compliance Officer?
cbnQuestions.riskAssessment: Do you conduct annual enterprise-wide AML risk assessments?
cbnQuestions.independentAudit: Do you conduct independent AML compliance audits annually?

cbnExplanations.collectsData: CBN AML regulations require customer due diligence for all financial services.
cbnExplanations.pepScreening: Enhanced due diligence required for high-risk customers.
cbnExplanations.complianceOfficer: Section 19 requires a designated Compliance Officer.

rem-privacy-policy.title: Publish a Privacy Policy
rem-privacy-policy.description: Your business collects personal data but lacks a privacy policy. NDP Act Section 27 requires transparent information about data processing.

rem-consent.title: Implement Consent Mechanism
rem-consent.description: Obtain explicit, informed consent before collecting personal data as required by NDP Act Section 26.

rem-children.title: Child Data Protection
rem-children.description: Implement age verification and parental consent for users under 18 per NDP Act Section 31.

rem-appoint-dpo.title: Appoint Data Protection Officer
rem-appoint-dpo.description: Designate a DPO as required for your processing activities under NDP Act Section 32.

rem-file-audit.title: File Compliance Audit Returns
rem-file-audit.description: Submit annual CAR filing to NDPC by March 31st as required by GAID 2025.

rem-register-ndpc.title: Register with NDPC
rem-register-ndpc.description: Register as a data controller/processor of major importance under NDP Act Section 44.

rem-dpia.title: Conduct Data Protection Impact Assessment
rem-dpia.description: Perform DPIA for high-risk processing activities per NDP Act Section 28.

rem-cross-border.title: Cross-Border Transfer Safeguards
rem-cross-border.description: Ensure adequate protection for international data transfers per NDP Act Sections 41-43.

rem-third-party.title: Third-Party Data Processing Agreements
rem-third-party.description: Execute written data processing agreements with all vendors and service providers.

rem-agf-coord.title: Attorney-General Federation Coordination
rem-agf-coord.description: Coordinate cross-border transfer approvals with the AGF office as required.

rem-cookie-consent.title: Cookie Consent Implementation
rem-cookie-consent.description: Implement cookie consent banner for website tracking and analytics.

cbn-kyc-implementation.title: Implement KYC Verification System
cbn-kyc-implementation.description: CBN AML regulations require customer identification and verification using BVN, NIN, or international passport for all financial services.

cbn-aml-policy.title: Establish AML/CFT Policy
cbn-aml-policy.description: Develop and implement a comprehensive Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Financing of Terrorism policy.

cbn-compliance-officer.title: Designate AML Compliance Officer
cbn-compliance-officer.description: Appoint a designated AML/CFT Compliance Officer responsible for overseeing all compliance matters.

cbn-transaction-monitoring.title: Implement Transaction Monitoring System
cbn-transaction-monitoring.description: Deploy real-time transaction monitoring to detect suspicious activities.

cbn-str-filing.title: Establish STR Filing Process
cbn-str-filing.description: Create process for filing Suspicious Transaction Reports to NFIU within 24 hours.

cbn-aml-training.title: Conduct Annual AML Training
cbn-aml-training.description: Provide annual AML/CFT training to all relevant employees.

cbn-record-keeping.title: Implement Record Keeping System
cbn-record-keeping.description: Establish system to retain transaction records for at least 5 years.

cbn-risk-assessment.title: Conduct AML Risk Assessment
cbn-risk-assessment.description: Perform annual enterprise-wide AML risk assessment.

cbn-independent-audit.title: Schedule Independent AML Audit
cbn-independent-audit.description: Conduct independent AML compliance audit annually.

cbn-pep-screening.title: Implement PEP Screening
cbn-pep-screening.description: Screen customers against Politically Exposed Persons lists.

cbn-fintech-licensing.title: Obtain CBN Fintech License
cbn-fintech-licensing.description: Secure appropriate CBN licensing for financial services operations.
